Vision Government Solutions

|

Granby, CT

|

Welcome

The Town of Granby contracted
with Vision Government Solutions to assist with the 2022 state mandated
revaluation project. Both the Assessor's
Office and Vision Government Solutions would like to thank Granby residents for
their patience and cooperation throughout the 2022 Revaluation project.

Shown on this site are the new assessments of all
taxable and exempt properties based on 70% of market value as of October 1, 2022.
The previous assessments were as of October 1, 2017.

Please
note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions, which will be applied
to the final assessments.

Please do not multiply the new assessment by
the current mill rate to estimate your taxes.
A new mill rate will be established once the grand list is finalized and
the budget is completed in the spring/summer of 2023.

Taxpayer Revaluation Link [https://www.granby-ct.gov/assessor/pages/revaluation-information]
